en.headline: Tai Kwun hosts talk on Sir Cecil Clementi and modern Hong Kong
en.dek: Historian Graham Hutchings discusses his new biography of the former governor at JC Cube this evening, with free admission requiring prior registration.
body: Tai Kwun holds a conversation this evening on Sir Cecil Clementi, the 17th governor of Hong Kong, and his role in shaping the modern city.

The session at JC Cube features Graham Hutchings, associate at the University of Oxford’s China Centre and honorary professor at the University of Nottingham, introducing his biography of Clementi. Historian Christopher Munn moderates.

Organisers said the talk runs from 7pm to 8:30pm, conducted in English with Cantonese simultaneous interpretation, followed by questions. Free admission is available with prior registration through Tai Kwun’s channels.
Clementi served as governor from 1925 to 1930 and was known for his command of Chinese languages and involvement in infrastructure and education projects during a period of significant change.

zh.headline: 大館今晚舉行金文泰講座 探討其與現代香港形成
zh.dek: 何傑明教授介紹其新著的前港督傳記，賽馬會立方晚上舉行，免費入場須預先登記。
body: 大館今晚舉行對談，探討第17任港督金文泰及其在塑造現代香港中的角色。
賽馬會立方的講座由牛津大學中國中心副研究員兼諾丁漢大學名譽教授何傑明介紹其金文泰傳記，歷史學家文基賢主持。
主辦方表示，講座由晚上7時至8時30分舉行，以英語進行並設粵語即時傳譯，其後有問答環節。免費入場，須透過大館渠道預先登記。
金文泰於1925至1930年出任港督，以其精通中文及在基建與教育項目上的參與而聞名，當時正值重大變革時期。
